material.title: Making Social Contact in the UK — short-answer questions
material.source_version: IELTS Sample Tasks 2023; isolated prompt excerpt

verification.method: Exact official PDF checksum matched source version; prompt p11, transcript p12 and key p13 read; prompt excerpt reopened and visually rendered; no answer pages copied.
verification.audio_verification: Official recording link inspected in exact source PDF p12; official CDN HTTP 200 audio/mpeg; downloaded ID3+MP3 parsed by afinfo without playback

freshness.basis: PROFILE.md, PROGRESS.md and AUDIT.md read on 2026-10-12; no recorded attempt/exposure for this task. Confirm learner has not seen key at session start.

material.delivery: Give local prompt-only PDF and local audio; Tata presses Play herself. Withhold full source PDF, key and transcript until done. Check playback support on the learning laptop without starting recording for Tata.

result_collection.primary: At initial attempt, learner answers directly in chat numbered 11–16, or writes on paper and sends a photo/screenshot. Never ask to retype all answers after done.

difficulty.note: No official band or difficulty assigned to this extract.

suggested_session.coach_timing_estimate: 2 minutes instructions, 1 minute scan, about 1 minute 33 seconds one play, 2 minutes finish/capture, 10 minutes feedback and one correction, remainder next action
suggested_session.score_policy: Report /6 only; no IELTS band. Respect order-independent pairs exactly as key p13 permits; count play from learner report, coach never starts it.

coach_reference.content: exact key and transcript/passage excerpts; never attach in learner instructions

provenance.reference: Jawaban awal Tata 11–16 di chat ini, 13 Oktober 2026; teks mentah termasuk entity dipertahankan.
Tata menjawab "3 kali" di chat ini pada 13 Oktober 2026 saat ditanya jumlah putaran audio Social Contact.

payload.text:
1. language
2. customs
3. music groups
4. local history groups
5. town hall 
6. public library

provenance.reference: Tata mengirim ulang enam jawaban Social Contact setelah key/feedback tersedia, 13 Oktober 2026. Penomoran 1–6 pada pesan ini merujuk urutan Q11–16 Social Contact, bukan jawaban Reading Marie Curie. Respons awal dan skor 4/6 dipertahankan.

result.verification_method: Jawaban awal chat dibandingkan dengan key dan transcript resmi PDF 2023, p12–13; references.py memverifikasi checksum/versi/nomor pada 13 Oktober 2026. Urutan dalam tiap pasangan bebas sesuai key.

answers.proof: Transcript p12 states language as one reason social contacts are difficult; key p13 language. Submitted languange adds n.
Transcript p12 states customs may be different; key p13 customs. Submitted custome differs in final letter; do not infer a hearing error from spelling alone.
Transcript p12 mentions joining music groups; key p13 music (groups), groups optional; Q13/14 either order.
Transcript p12 mentions a local history group; key p13 local history (groups), groups optional; Q13/14 either order.
Transcript p12 gives town hall as a place for information; key p13 accepts (the) town hall; Q15/16 either order. HTML space entity in raw message treated as formatting.
Transcript p12 gives public library as a place for information; key p13 accepts (the) (public) library/libraries; Q15/16 either order.

feedback.strength: Empat jawaban isi lengkap benar: music groups, local history groups, town hall, public library.
patterns: Ejaan jawaban 11–12 belum tepat: languange → language; custome → customs. Ini observasi attempt ini, belum kelemahan menetap atau bukti salah mendengar.
feedback.action: Review 1 menit: tulis language dan customs masing-masing sekali tanpa melihat, lalu cek ejaan dan akhiran -s. Simpan sebagai review setelah key terekspos, bukan skor baru.
feedback.next_task: Reading Marie Curie, True/False/Not Given Q1–3; cadangan Reading Development of Rockets Q7–10 sesuai rotasi.

result.uncertainty: Audio diputar 3 kali menurut laporan Tata; latihan dengan pengulangan, bukan pengukuran sekali putar. Paparan key sebelumnya dan durasi aktual belum diketahui; jangan simpulkan kenaikan band.
